mapper.select: SELECT * FROM group_purchase WHERE status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_purchase (gp_id, author_id, product_name, product_url, unit_price, group_price, target_quantity, deadline) VALUES (#{gpId}, #{authorId}, #{productName}, #{productUrl}, #{unitPrice}, #{groupPrice}, #{targetQuantity}, #{deadline})
mapper.update: UPDATE group_purchase SET current_quantity = current_quantity + #{quantity} WHERE gp_id = #{gpId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gp_participant (participant_id, gp_id, member_id, quantity) VALUES (#{participantId}, #{gpId}, #{memberId}, #{quantity})
